C0745.title: Stealing a Phone After Resignation and Impersonating the Victim to Commit Fraud
C0745.summary: In January 2021, an employee named Zhang at a company in Changzhou, Jiangsu, stole a colleague's phone from a dormitory upon resignation. He then used information on the phone to log into the victim's bank account, transfer the balance, and impersonate the victim to defraud the victim's sister of over 20,000 yuan.
